events.road.the_hitchhiker.title: Somebody Wants a Lift
events.road.the_hitchhiker.body: A figure on the verge with one bag and no coat, arm out, not waving. There is nothing behind them for twenty kilometres and nothing ahead for thirty. They do not look desperate. They look like they have done this before and expect it to work.
events.road.the_hitchhiker.out.good_comp: They talk for an hour, then stop talking, which is the better trick. They know which fuel stop is open late and why the short way is not.
The second one is easier. You know what to ask, and they know you are not going to ask anything else.
By now you have a system. They get in, you say where you are going, and either it suits them or it does not.
events.road.the_hitchhiker.out.long_sile: Neither of you finds anything to say for ninety kilometres. It is not hostile. It is just very long.
The same silence as last time, with a different person in it. You are starting to think it might be you.
You stop trying after the first ten minutes and put the radio on instead.
events.road.the_hitchhiker.out.they_take: They get out at a junction with more than they got in with, and you work out which pocket about a kilometre later.
events.road.the_hitchhiker.out.watched_i: They do not lower the arm. You watch them get smaller for a long time, which is longer than you expected to.
You have got better at not looking in the mirror. Not good, but better.
You do not slow down this time, and you do not look, and it bothers you rather more than the first one did.
events.road.the_hitchhiker.choice.leave_: Put them out at the junction
events.road.the_hitchhiker.out.parted_ba: You stop somewhere that is not anywhere and say you are turning off. They know you are not. Neither of you argues about it.
events.road.the_first_hour.title: The First Hour
events.road.the_first_hour.body: The bag has been packed twice and is no lighter. Outside it is the colour of not-yet, and the road out of town is one you have taken a hundred times to get somewhere else. Everything after the first junction is new. You have been ready for twenty minutes.
events.road.the_first_hour.out.moving_be: You are moving before you have decided you are moving, which turns out to be the only way it was ever going to happen.
events.road.the_first_hour.out.forty_kil: Forty kilometres out you work out what is still on the table by the door. It is not important. It bothers you for the rest of the morning.
events.road.the_first_hour.choice.buy_wh: Buy what you are short of
events.road.the_first_hour.out.stocked_a: Water, something to eat that will keep, and a receipt you fold into a pocket you will not find again. It costs most of the morning and it is the right call.
events.road.the_first_hour.out.everythin: Half of it goes back on the shelf. What is left fits in one bag and weighs nothing, and there is now nothing to fall back on.
events.road.the_first_hour.choice.ask_so: Ask somebody who has done it
events.road.the_first_hour.out.two_usefu: He runs it most months. He tells you two things that are obvious and one that is not, and the one that is not is worth the hour.
events.road.the_first_hour.out.everyone_: Four people, four routes, four confident accounts of ground none of them has covered since the year before last.
events.road.the_first_hour.out.the_man_w: There is a man who knows a man, and the introduction costs what an introduction costs. You are fairly sure you have bought nothing at all.
